Fist of Bane Aminah is a duergar cultist of Bane in the Steel Watch Foundry next to  Fist of Bane Polandulus.
“
I heard the Black Hand's favoured can command the room with a single word. And that he knows no fear.
„
— Aminah, fangirling about Gortash

Involvement

Aminah is on the lab level of the Steel Watch Foundry, and watches over the Gondians who are forced to work there to produce the Steel Watchers for  Enver Gortash.

Idle banter

Aminah occasionally chats with Polandulus:

  • Fist of Bane Aminah
    It's been an age since Gortash's last visit.
  • Fist of Bane Polandulus
    Lord Gortash - you have not earned such familiarity.
  • Fist of Bane Aminah
    Forgive me, Dread Brother. I simply... wish to look upon Bane's Chosen once more.
  • Fist of Bane Aminah
    I heard the Black Hand's favoured can command the room with a single word. And that he knows no fear.
  • Fist of Bane Polandulus
    Instead of sharing idle gossip about Lord Gortash, I suggest you focus on your duties.
  • Fist of Bane Aminah
    Of course, Dread Brother.
  • Fist of Bane Aminah
    Have you ever spoken to him?
  • Fist of Bane Polandulus
    Lord Gortash? Only once. I felt the Black Hand's power in every word.
  • Fist of Bane Aminah
    To speak to him, face-to-face? The very thought sends chills up my spine.
  • Fist of Bane Polandulus
    You are a long way from such an honour.

Notes

  • Gamefiles suggest her name was originally 'Abiflores'. See synopsis of LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_AD_BaneiteGossip02
